# LitosUI

> A framework-agnostic UI component library built with Web Components and TypeScript.

## Documentation languages

- [中文文档索引](https://dvshu.github.io/litos-ui/llms-zh.txt)
- [English documentation index](https://dvshu.github.io/litos-ui/llms-en.txt)

## Full documentation

- [中文全文](https://dvshu.github.io/litos-ui/llms-zh-full.txt)
- [English full documentation](https://dvshu.github.io/litos-ui/llms-en-full.txt)

## Content policy

Chinese documentation is the source of truth. English translations may lag behind. If the two versions differ, prefer the Chinese documentation. English-path pages may still contain untranslated content.

The language indexes cover the guides and components in the site sidebars; marketing home pages are omitted.
